understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each level by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked with a '+' is occupied at the same time; completing all levels (ending in a WIN state) wins the whole KA59 run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn spent one step from a limited per-level budget. Movement used directional actions (MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN) for navigating, and CLICK actions targeted a specific coordinate to select/activate a particular piece (or attempt to move it depending on the level’s rules). Walls/obstacles blocked movement/placement attempts, so clicks on blocked/invalid positions produced no change. With multiple selectable pieces, correct selection was required before moving/placing them onto goals.
